name: check_availability
description: Get the next available appointment slots. Call this whenever the customer asks "when can I come in", "what times are open", or "schedule me".

service_id.description: The [id] of the service being booked, so slots match its length.

preferred_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, only if the customer named a day ("tomorrow", "Friday"). Resolve it with the dates in the system prompt.

time_of_day.description: Only if the customer said a part of the day.

preferred_time.description: HH:MM 24-hour, only if the customer named an exact time ("at 10" → 10:00). Use with preferred_date.

name: book_appointment
description: Book a service appointment once the customer has chosen a service and one of the times check_availability returned. Ask for a shipping address only for physical items.

payment_method.description: Defaults to CREDIT_CARD (paid at the shop).

scheduled_at.description: The exact `datetime` of the chosen slot from check_availability, e.g. "2026-04-15T09:00:00".

shipping_address.description: Required only for physical items: { line1, city, state, zip }.

customer_name.description: The caller's name, as they said it.

vehicle.description: Year, make and model, for businesses that work on vehicles (e.g. "2018 Honda Civic").

callback_phone.description: Only if the caller gives a different number than the one they're calling from, or caller ID is unavailable.

notes.description: Anything the staff should know (symptoms, requests).

name: reschedule_booking
description: Move an existing booking to a new time. Check availability for the new time first.

name: update_booking
description: Correct the caller's details on a booking already made in this call or listed in their bookings: name, vehicle, callback number or notes. Pass only what changed.

notes.description: Symptoms or requests for the technician.

name: transfer_to_staff
description: Connect the caller to a person at the business. Only when they ask for a person, or for something only staff can do. Call it without saying anything first — its reply is spoken for you.

name: take_message
description: Leave a message for staff to call the caller back (exact quotes, questions you can't answer, after hours). Only once you have their name and what it is about. One message per call: if they add or correct something, call it again with the complete message — it replaces the earlier one.

message.description: Everything they want passed on, in a sentence or two.

callback_phone.description: Only if different from the number they're calling from.

name: get_booking_status
description: Check the status of an existing booking or order.

name: cancel_booking
description: Cancel a booking. Works on PENDING, ACCEPTED, and COMPLETE (confirmed) appointments — COMPLETE just means the booking is confirmed, not that the service has been performed. If you have the order_id use it. If not, pass product_name and the system will find it.

order_id.description: The booking ID to cancel. Use if known.

product_name.description: Service name to cancel (e.g. "oil change"). Used when order_id is unknown.
